notes.title: Build13 is now live.
notes.content:
[h1]The World is Saved[/h1]
Now your character will be saved every 1 minute. If the server is closed and re-opened, your Inventory and Bank Account will be the same as the last save. The worst case is that it rolled back 1 minute at most. You can carry your wealth across updates given that the savegame is not broken or deleted.

The savegame system will cover more items in the later updates.

[h1]Banking Service[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/d69093af8bc203916ec7fe7df43cbce457cbdf32.jpg[/img]

You can request banking operations via an ATM. Currently, available operations are
[list]
[*] Import Steam Currency Items to your bank account in the server.
[*] Export your banknotes from the server into Steam Items.
[*] Deposit your banknotes into your account
[*] Withdraw your banknotes from your account
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/93fe5ac5c804004ae4ae85fff94c1af9017d20d9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/8758f92c2bb9937e4d0791ca7bfab632b00009de.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/823ce961fbe58c6853a975ba4d47179e79a1e848.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bonds and Funds[/h1]
There are 4 Bonds and 2 Funds. Bondholders can manually claim 5% of the bond's interest every 4 hours. In total, you will receive 300% interest from the bond's base price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/eb5d35b8897d53b5c985826da817d88b1ac7e4ef.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/94eb5dd8c5c653f06006a9c9cbc8a5a61e2a38c0.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/5d19bfd0639489de4f057305285bc101be7e1873.jpg[/img]

Funds are currently importable but not usable yet. They will be used by the Local Governments in the future.

These banking functionalities are the foundation of the LittleArctic Economy. So I chose to implement them early, even though there are not many items to buy yet.

notes.title: Build11 is now live.
notes.content:
[h1]You have new jobs[/h1]

I implemented the new job system. It's a contract-based job. The contractee(job giver) creates a contract with some requirements, like tools and ingredients. Once the contract is resolved, the contractor who worked on that contract will receive payment.

You can see the contract details by holding the right mouse. Some contracts require a specific tool, you need to equip it and hold the left mouse button to work on that contract.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/af8f6ecfd27165988350b050e8dc698be8d4ced5.jpg[/img]

You cannot work on the contract if the required ingredients are missing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/d35134d572a558394c8294b998928a094280f34a.jpg[/img]

You can interact with the station's clipboard to browse sale offers. You may need to buy some ingredients from one station and sell them to another station to fulfill the contract needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/ad68df281e41674d10ffb00ea9af06dbd99f24f1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/424dd0747c0c6c2e17dffb5a60109079b7693d9e.jpg[/img]


Currently, only government contracts are available. In the later update, people can buy the job station and create their contracts too.

[h2]The unboxing table is back[/h2]
If you have some lootbox items, you can open them at this table. Also, there are items for sale with Labour Union Credit(LUC) including 2 lootboxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/e01a5b47701b94497a8da834c2ec81b440357e3d.jpg[/img]

If you find a bug, you can report the bug with this telephone. It will redirect the message to my Discord.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/f0518595b81c59b76c084ee7179e7f6df8f3a7db.jpg[/img]

[h2]I want to push new Build every month as possible[/h2]
Build11 has too many coding and reworks which make the update take almost a year. I want to make a smaller update every month instead. I hope that the plan works.

notes.title: Devblog#36 The Reboot Version is now on the DefaultBranch
notes.content:
[h1]I cleaned up the Server and accidentally forget how to set the Config File[/h1]

The Server used for Build8 was created almost 2 years ago. Normally I will just restart the server regularly without touching the config file. This time though, I delete the server and download the clean version of Build8 and it cannot start because I have to set the config file which I forget already.

So I brought the latest version on the ExperimentalBranch to the NormalBranch instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/baacadccfc6495284cb1fd428c6d9caa298899c8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/6b0b5f15933fca875205a8bf0545117e80684a2a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/cf44ff2a03b66eaa607f50c7a52f7623c549472f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Reboot Version[/h1]

This version doesn't inherit from Build8 at all. So there are many features that are still missing. I'm so sorry for the inconvenience.

However, there is a new feature introduced, it is "Discord Semi-Proximity VoiceChat". It works like a Proximity VoiceChat but the volume is constant(not change according to the distance). The talking radius is around 5 meters. [u][b]The system requires you to have Discord opened and logged in before you enter the game. The Push-to-Talk button is LeftAlt.[/b][/u]

[h3]Some Technical Details[/h3]
[list]
[*]It is built on Unreal Engine 5 (Build8 used Unreal Engine 4)
[*]Doesn't use Lumen yet(Lumen makes lighting more beautiful but can be a burden on lower-end machines)
[*]Doesn't use Nanite for the same reason and this feature will require a DirectX12-supported machine to run so I don't plan to use it anytime soon.
[*]Framerate is currently capped at 60 FPS until I create an options menu.
[*]I lower the resolution to 45% of the screen but add the SuperSampling as an Anti-Aliasing method. I expect a decent/good picture and smoother framerate.
[*]Require a DirectX11-supported machine to run. (Also update Graphic Driver to the latest version)
[/list]

[h1]Next?[/h1]

I will continue to accumulate new features on the ExperimentalBranch. The next version on the DefaultBranch will be called [u][b]Build9[/b][/u] despite missing many features and gameplay I promised earlier. I will bring back "The Welcome Box" very soon. ːfuelcanː

notes.title: Devblog#35 I'm back, for more.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/a049784d125bfe2673fa796d089578a7c311a556.jpg[/img]

[h1]What happen since the last update?[/h1]

   It's almost 2 years since the latest update(Build8) was released. About a year ago, I was preparing for moving to a new house. The house wasn't even finished built at that time but I have to haul heavy things and wait. And the bad news came, my grandma was getting ill. My mom said that we don't have much time to live with her. I felt sad deep to all my bones, so worried but I still working on the game anyway.
We managed to move to the new house. My back was in severe pain from lifting heavy stuff. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/459c0c7a9c3f80862c265f7541506cc612e2993a.jpg[/img]

   A week later we move my grandma to the same house. We live together for almost a month. Then one morning she breathe very lightly. My uncle took her to the hospital. I waited. He came back and simply said, "Grandma is passed away, she's now transferred to the temple".

That was the most silent moment in my life.

  After the funeral, I started gardening like my grandma does all her life. I then adopt a female cat named Lily(so sad she was pregnant and left my house just on the labour day, I miss her so much).ː2017catheartː Then I adopt another male cat named Stryker, which he lost with his mom after the rainstorm.ːtigerinablanketː

Now, I have to accept that my grandma also has her own journey to heaven. Maybe she is watching me doing good things and I still have a chance to show her how Villages™ succeeds in the end.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/58bc4400c38b26f4c5027a946a0285f1cce1f390.jpg[/img]

So my(our) new journey begins here.

[h1] Sometimes, Reboot means just throwing everything away and starting in an all-new way.[/h1]

The week after my grandma passed away, I feel I don't have to rush for anything.  Also, I heard about the coming of the Unreal Engine 5 so it's the perfect time to start from the beginning(AKA Rebootingːcleansealː).

I've tried and played with new features from Unreal Engine 5, and read and done deep research on some techniques. I found that I should exercise my new doctrine for developing Villages™. The plan is I will not promise what will come next in the new version. But instead, I will just push each small update to the experimental branch until I feel that the accumulated features are enough to be promoted to MainBranch. Then I will push those updates to the MainBranch and go back to work on an ExprimentalBranch again.

It looks like this diagram except it doesn't inherit anything from Build8 at all.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/8d4d93db5ef388a8afc70e980a911ebdd9fc07f8.png[/img]

The new version is already uploaded in the experimental branch. It barely has any features at all but  you can test if your machine can run the new engine or not. Tonight, I will continue developing the game on this branch immediately so the XP-Server may not available. I will just post a simple Update Log for every version on the Experimental Branch and only post Devblog for the MainBranch to tell you all new interesting updates.

notes.title: Devblog# 33: What I did last Winter
notes.content:
[h1]I prepared the whole system to support Mods[/h1]
It's better to design the system to be mod-able from the start than have to hack here and there after the game is released. I've created a framework for modding language translations. You can simply copy and replace the text of your own language, or even the English one (to replace confusing item codenames with the legit ones). The other mods like vehicles will be available later this year.

[previewyoutube=tdiEaQD5D9c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]I re-modeled a lot of vehicles and also made a new vehicle system, one last time[/h1]
This is arguably a waste of time for someone. Why don't just buy it or download it for free somewhere?; someone asked. I'm a vehicles enthusiast. I want to be able to control how vehicles are created. I want to be able to control the quality of them by myself. So the only way is to roll the sleeves up and learn how to model them.

The result is somehow acceptable. I know I can get better next time.
This car is the most polished in the fleet but it will be improved later too.
https://sketchfab.com/models/f489729ee3bf4ce2ba1a39360d09091b

I just found the easiest way to make a vehicle physics system. It uses just connected physics constraints. So everyone can make their own vehicles as mods. This video is just the first version I made last week. The later version is way better but I didn't record it yet.
[previewyoutube=MqirmhDvaoI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Then the Winter's gone, my working computer starts to be fried again.[/h1]
In my country, the temperature is very high. Plus my computer doesn't have proper airflow. My computer can easily shut itself off after working on 3D-Things for a couple of minutes. Even it's my second new computer but it inherits some parts from the old one, like the CPU fan and the Power Supply. This is my worst nightmare.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/b032e605206e873d52436dfb126caa562e40ede5.jpg[/img]
I wish this computer will live long enough before I receive more budget, one way or another.

[h1]The Wait-Time will be shorter if I can show you the project's timeline[/h1]

Villages™ will not consider completed or even decent without vehicles. When it comes to open-world games, transportation is very important. notes.title: Devblog #8 Found a new way to bypass the market matching problem/ Revive packing map temporarily
notes.content:
[h1]Alternative to the Commodity Market[/h1]
Currently there is a market matching limitation which buyer cannot buy items from same listing more than one time. When some items sold as stack at lowest price from only one seller, after buyers buy that type of items for the first time they cannot but that item anywhere else. For short, it is a [b][u]Market Locked[/u][/b] situation.

I found that if item has tag applied to it, it will not sell in the commodity market. This way buyer can manually buy items one by one [b]without locking[/b].

So I created new TagItem called [b]"Fast-Sale Seal"[/b]. It can apply to one item and then that item can be sold in Fast-Sale Market even sell as a stack.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/749d6b57e6ce171ce69dfc54f33b4fd4e6fb66fd.png[/img]

I will introduce this Seal in about next 3-4 updates.

[h1]ItemPacker is Back[/h1]
Due to new solution I found, I can bring back itempacker map for us all. I will also add packing into experimental branch too, not sure when though. You can now switch to itempacker branch without using password.

notes.title: Devblog #5 Try New Vehicle System on XP Branch, Re-Explain About Items
notes.content:

I success creating and tuning a new vehicle. This car called "Little Hauler", use in construction site. Currently it use just simple control but I will add engine and gear later. As you will see there are no visual wheels yet, I will add it later as well.

The main importance of the new system is the vehicles can modified in-game like change engine characteristic, change power, suspension and tire etc. This way player who has mechanic skill can adjust vehicles both cosmetic and driving.

I will update in only Experimental Branch(XP) until the game is ready to enter V0.3.0. You can try new things by opt-in experimentalbranch. Only warning here is I will update this branch quite frequently and may annoying you when it require download so you can opt-out this branch anytime.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/90981c81b1e8e08202d1dd2396116d0545f1b5ee.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/886b90f461da09d24e07116a91ef42e8fe4450a7.jpg[/img]


[h1]Explain About Items Again[/h1]
In "Villages", most of items are consumable. First time I introduced items because I didn't implement Save System, I use items as a form of savegame that save your effort for playing my game. But I found that the items can be used as core mechanic and economy of the game so I'm all-in for this.

Current official version(V0.2.0) may look weird because it grant many items and no packing anymore. You may frustrate a lot but in real situation you guys just cannot produce the same items as other players because producing items will cost you another items, if you produce the same thing the price will go down and you won't get profit. You will going to compete with other in this game of business.

So V0.2.0 is a demonstration of "Use Something to Produce Something". This version will stay until V0.3.0.  In V0.3.0 you will get items in more different ways.

notes.title: Devblog #4 Progression on New Vehicle System
notes.content:
[h1]Why do I have to change?[/h1]

In V0.1.0, the car made from PhysxVehicle. While it's quite drivable at that time but it's hard to tune and modify to make more complex vehicle (Crane Truck, Chinook with wheels etc.). So I have to make new vehicle system that is simple and easy to modify. It's simplicity will also benefit in networking performance because it will use minimal computation by the design. However I will make sure it must fun and feel good enough to drive or fly, I'm also a gamer myself anyway.

[h1]Actual Progression[/h1]

Now I'm able to make a foundation of a wheeled vehicle. It now hoverable and has lateral friction. I will add more things until it can do what old system can.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/643925b8828847ffb26fc6033382e826a60844bb.png[/img]

[h1]About Third-Person View and others[/h1]

Some of our friends ask me about Third-Person View, I told him I want this game to be FPS-only. But now I change my mind, after I play other games and feel they are more attractive when players can see their avatar. So I decide to bring back Third-Person View(Switchable), expect to added in V0.3.0. But shooting in TPV will not accurate at all, you will have to swich to FPV to get more accuracy by sacrifice your vision(Stealth Gameplay will posible).

Other design decision is Outfit and Mobile Phone are things that cannot be looted by other players when you are downed (for convenience reason).

I will continue researching more about vehicles both from real things and from other games.

See you next time.:emofdr:

[i]Labour Bond[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/4d43007b25d1b21ec3d721ad081c445ed0248b79.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/7725c6249adc3f8d897248f7a2f9d57b2959568c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/068b41dc6d44e25591ff45484bea086c34f241f1.jpg[/img]

After that you will need to import items from CargoService (at the blue mini-container office nearby). [b][u]Importing will consume you Steam Items.[/u][/b] 
Importable items for now are
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/d32716d79efb5b7d97f14d13f986ab5843434951.png[/img]
[i]People's Car[/i] need for People's Roadster
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/129374c7d39b6849d8fede84da135b1c14b26268.png[/img]
[i]Heavy Oil (Barrel)[/i] 200 Litres
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/8cc4bb1b7affcd8587d3506d802ef9204fe3a84e.png[/img]
[i]Heavy Oil (Tank)[/i] 20,000 Litres

You can import specific amount of item.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/376021864221055694cceba4c2f10cc6146021ce.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/7131520fbff10b067570ce69b80c37321d88b8b7.jpg[/img]

You may need to click refresh button to see if your cargo is update.

Now you can go to any small factory to order new items. If your order success [b][u]you'll see that money and oil decrease from your account.[/u][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/3d60bb9161cce09267ef71b47f88fc7a6c7a981f.jpg[/img]

Every factory have limited capacity so each of them will accept order only one per person. This mean you can have maximum 20 orders(from 20 factories) at a time in one server.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/358ca1bc1306ca9da7e578339469613c6f964399.jpg[/img]

Every order need 15 minutes to complete. When the order completed they will send new items to your inventory automatically and you even don't have be in the game. [b]For example, if your order is the 20th in a queue you have to wait (15x20=300 Minutes) 5 hours.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/98f80ae500b003f597433dbbf62efee6a6f44d16.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/da50eee024871d9463ee35a7ea3561afcb155a58.jpg[/img]

[h1]What I will do next?[/h1]
- [b][u]remove itempacker branch[/u][/b] , the reason is I need you to sell item only quantity of 1 per listing like typical games(as many listing you need). Because matching system has limitation which allow any buyer to buy from any listing only once. So when someone sell item in stack and sell the cheapest, buyer will can only buy for the first time, the second time will not success(the market will get clogged in this case). So new set of item will unlikely to cause this problem.(1 item per listing).
- Swap V0.1.4 to [b]testdrivemap[/b] branch. So you can play that map and get items until it expired. On 1st September that map will stop dropping item forever. So if you need some items you will need to get them before that day.
- Rework on Vehicle Physics. If it goes well we'll have Land,Air and Sea Vehicle in one research.
- Rework on Character movement for reduce jittering.
- Create my own netcode, for better networked gameplay.

I'll trying to make new small experimental rather than big update like this and make it modular for easy testing. You can join my Discord for Bug Reporting [url=https://discord.gg/ddbTzSu][/url]


[h1]You can send me financial support (or tell someone to do)[/h1]
to one of these links.
[url=https://www.paypal.me/simonjames247][/url]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/simonjames247][/url]


See you next time. :emofdr:

notes.title: Devblog #1 with update V0.1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Important Note[/h1]
[b]After this version there will be no minor update or bugfix until Version 0.2.0[/b]
I will only add more items to "The International Market" as v0.1.1.
I need about 4 months to rework all major system include Co-op Mode, Dedicated Server Mode, Voice Chat and more.
[b]Next announcement expected to be on 13th July 2018.[/b]

But I will post Devblog when the game has progression.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/2e115b2aa887c23db14476beb7b9955d37df464b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Before go to actual update[/h1]

I must explain some basic rules that will comprise to the complex economy in Villages.

1.Steam Item can be obtained in [b]Dedicated-Server Mode only.[/b] 
But before V0.2.0 I allow purchasing in SinglePlayer/Coop mode for limited time.

Ability to redeem Steam item for in game item and to exchange between Steam item(unboxing, claim Lottery) still allowed in the final version of game in every modes.

2. You can exchange in-game item to Steam item with 2:1 ratio, plus transportation fee and tax. (From CargoService to The International Market).
So now is the best time for stock goods due to temporary 1:1 exchange ratio.


[h1]Now an actual update[/h1]

- You still have one job that is "Test Driving" but this time the car has manual transmission. You have to drive along the road to the end.  If you really reach the end point you will get 1 Payload and need to deliver it at where you start and you will recieve 30000 Kattas.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/cebb0339d1aef5aff0b72437521d5c5efb4630dd.jpg[/img]

- You can spend your hard-earned money at Trading Post by using the computer that has direct access to The International Market.

The limitations are you can only purchase one item for each type per processing(every 90 seconds). After puchases order is in queue you can leave the Trade Post, when order completed there will be notifications messages send to you. [b]No save implemented yet[/b] so make sure you spend all money before leave the game.

- About every 10 minutes when you [b]vistit Trading Post[/b] you will recieve Bonds interest from "LittileArctic Government".(calculated from every bonds you hold in your Steam Inventory) There are 4 Bonds available, all of them give 5% of their value for example "Business Bond has 1 million Kattas in value will give 50,000 Kattas interest".
[b]In final version the interest will automatically paid per real-time hours by Dedicated-Server you playing in and time is accumulate only when you are actually playing in that server.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/6c586795c94da0c880b272b6b9944f55c71ebea2.jpg[/img]

- If your car really stuck you can reset it by walk in front of a phone booth.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/433bdf95aabde375755b431f33963104f852ed9f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/98c66e6b235f578ad3671c74d29476ee8e7c6eb5.jpg[/img]

-If yourself stuck in terrain,[b] try press R when you align your face out of object you stuck in.[/b]

- If you cannot unstuck [b] press Home to teleport to the base.[/b]

[h1]P.S.[/h1]

 I will add a few more items to The International Market within a week as v0.1.1 but without announcement.(See version in upper-left corner in the game)

See you next time. ːemofdrː
